source: Read-only PostgreSQL SELECT in the isolated WebArena Reddit deployment

rows.post_title: Adults reading to each other out loud?
A custom gaming PC built inside a vintage 1940s Motorola radio case

query_scope: submission_votes joined to submissions and users for the two exact post IDs and the authenticated voter; no other rows or credentials exported
conclusion_zh: 两次回放的同一已登录用户投票均存在于站点数据库，目标 ID、方向和回放前后页面分数变化一致；官方网络规则同时通过。页面分数单独不足以证明用户投票，数据库关联行补足了这一证据。
conclusion_en: Both same-user votes persisted in the site database with the target IDs and directions shown by the before/after page scores; the official network rules also passed. Page-score changes alone do not prove voter identity, which is supplied by the database-linked rows.
